title: COSPEC Comparison Harness and Evaluation Dataset
description: An automated comparison harness and the complete 150-trial dataset supporting the evaluation of COSPEC, Spec-Driven Development using GitHub Spec Kit, and vibe coding. The dataset contains five conditions, two cross-model Maker/Director pairs (Claude and Codex), three Maker reasoning-effort levels, and five repetitions per combination. It includes archived dialogues, presented artifacts, implementation workspaces, 600 final Claude/Codex judgments, and reproducible descriptive analyses, 16 exact paired permutation tests with Holm correction, and requirement-level inter-rater agreement. The evaluation uses LLM-simulated client roles, not human participants.
